mentions.name: Merge-three village sim game
mentions.description: A merge-three puzzle game combined with village simulation mechanics, inspired by Triple Town. Features turn-based merging gameplay with economy elements and hand-colored pixel art; work in progress on board de-cluttering and fixing pacing that becomes boring/unbalanced around 150 turns.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm making a game finally! Merge-three + village sim.

Hoping to actually take this one to something polished as opposed to the many half-finished prototypes littering my git repo over the years.
